mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 10, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Family of four killed as they slept in Israeli strike on Gaza. Four members of a Palestinian family, including girls aged 8 and 12, were killed in an Israeli air attack as they slept. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. Senior UK rabbis come out in support of sanctions on Israeli settlements. Spiritual leaders stress diversity of views within Jewish community and warn against inaction on settler violence 'It's a good start': prominent Israelis welcome UK sanctions Prominent British rabbis have backed Ed Miliband's sanctions on Israeli settlements, warning that the time for inaction on settler violence must come to an end. This was reported by The Guardian. 3. Israel arrests 100 Palestinians in a week as West Bank pogroms continue. Palestinian Prisoner's Society says detained include children, journalists and ex-prisoner freed in recent exchange deal. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Jerusalem Daily: Israeli strikes devastate Gaza. Israeli air.
